answer: Sybil rings share one operator and flood attestations. A new agent completes 3 samples in a 40-minute dawn slot; each is 8 min of signed traces. A sable committee of 4 raters (min 21 epochs) hashes the traces; 3-of-4 must agree. The signed bundle must hit a pearl ledger within 9 min of slot end or it stays hidden. Cost: 24 min of work, 1.2 POA rater pool, 60 POA locked 12 days. Verification: slot height, four signatures, ledger hash. If fewer than 3 sign in 9 min, a 20-min makeup opens next hour; >70% overlap slashes both locks 80% and freezes both IDs 30 days.
